Geographies Served Programs Nursery school District Thane State Maharashtra District Thane States Maharashtra The initial six years of a child's life hold immense importance, fostering their physical, linguistic, and social development. Thus, investing in Early Childhood Care and Education is crucial. MESCO initiated its first institutional project, the English medium Nursery Schools program, in a Bandra slum pocket back in 1977. This doorstep school enabled children to qualify in admission tests for high schools in the vicinity, helping them gain access to quality mainstream education. In 2009, the Nursery Schools project was brought under the purview of the MESCO Education Society and has since been under its management. Vocational training centre District Thane State Maharashtra District Thane States Maharashtra To integrate dropout students back into mainstream society by equipping them with technical skills and fostering self-reliance, Mesco Education Society initiated a Vocational Training Centre in 2008 at Mumbra Kausa, Maharashtra. This centre was established in collaboration with Fr. Agnel Technical College, Bandra. Imparting technical skills would not only transform the lives of individual dropout students but also positively impact society as a whole. Milestones & Track Record MESCO Education Society has established multiple educational institutions across Pune and Mumbai, becoming a preferred choice for quality education among students from various parts of the country and abroad. --> --> Leadership Team Dr. Mohammed Abbas Khatkhatay President Mrs. Najma Kazi Vice President Mrs. Shama Tarapurwala General Secretary Prof. Mohammed Farhaan Makba Treasurer Mr. Idris Bhoira Managing Committee Member Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATM3760D Registration Number F-4703 CSR Form 1 CSR00006173 VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2017/0166307 --> 80G AAATM3760DF20214 12A AAATM3760DE20214 FCRA 83780433 About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 1977 Demographies Served Youth Children Teachers Girls Adolescents --> Impact Over its years of operation, MESCO Education Society has helped shape the careers of numerous graduates, post-graduates, engineers, doctors, and other professionals, contributing significantly to the educational landscape. Vision and Mission The vision of MESCO Education Society is to empower society with men and women of integrity and character through holistic education and skilled training, while its mission is to develop industry-oriented manpower capable of facing the challenges of globalization.
